tasks.subject: Add sq ft bar and SIZE/POSITION tabs to controls.js
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewrite buildPanel to add sq ft summary bar, SIZE/POSITION tabs, and position sliders for outbuildings. Update initControls to expose updateSqft.

**Files:**
- Modify: `controls.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Sq ft bar pinned below header: width×depth per building + running total
- [ ] SIZE tab (default) shows existing dimension sliders for all 4 buildings
- [ ] POSITION tab shows East/West + North/South sliders for guestHouse, gym, garage (±120ft, step 1)
- [ ] Main house has no position sliders
- [ ] Dragging any dimension slider updates sq ft bar live
- [ ] Position slider writes to CONFIG[key].position.x/.z and calls onRebuild(key)
- [ ] initControls returns { update, updateSqft }

**Verify:** Open http://localhost:8080/scene.html — sq ft bar visible; click POSITION tab → position sliders appear; drag Guest House East/West → building moves; drag Main House Width → sq ft total updates.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["controls.js"], "verifyCommand": "http://localhost:8080/scene.html — sq ft bar, tabs, position sliders", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Sq ft bar visible", "SIZE/POSITION tabs", "Position sliders ±120ft", "Main house fixed", "updateSqft in return"]}
```

tasks.subject: Add cascade rebuilds to main.js
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add cascade rebuild logic to rebuildBuilding so garage→breezeway and mainHouse→patio+breezeway auto-follow.

**Files:**
- Modify: `main.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Dragging Garage East/West also repositions breezeway automatically
- [ ] Changing mainHouse dimensions also rebuilds patio and breezeway
- [ ] rebuildBuilding('__all__') still works without double-rebuilding

**Verify:** Drag Garage East/West → breezeway follows; drag Main House Width → patio stretches.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main.js"], "verifyCommand": "http://localhost:8080/scene.html — garage move cascades to breezeway", "acceptanceCriteria": ["garage→breezeway cascade", "mainHouse→patio+breezeway cascade"]}
```
